verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-006 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-006: a suspended or disabled staff account and a disabled service principal have no valid sessions or usable credentials
quotes: "authenticate after the principal was disabled",
AuthenticationRejected,
lambda: module.authenticate_service_principal(store, issue.secret),
"issue a credential for a disabled principal",
AuthorizationRejected,
verdicts.why: The check detects unusable credentials after disabling a service principal and refuses issuing it new credentials. It does not test suspended or disabled staff accounts or whether their sessions are invalidated.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-029 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; INV-029 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-029: a producer import is authorized for the target project per scope_mode and grants before content validation
quotes: assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, PROJECT_ID) is True
assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, OTHER_PROJECT_ID) is False
assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, PROJECT_ID) is True, (
assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, ARCHIVED_PROJECT_ID) is False
verdicts.why: The check asserts scope decisions for granted-projects and all-projects principals. It does not execute a producer import or establish that authorization occurs before content validation.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: read value unchanged [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal]; read value unchanged [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: A value read from a repository is unchanged after any use case that read it.
quotes: assert disabled.name == principal.name and disabled.created_at == principal.created_at
assert store.transaction.repository.mutated is False
verdicts.why: The check verifies preservation of selected principal values and that one rejected grant-revocation path does not invoke repository mutation. It does not assert that every repository value remains unchanged after every use case that reads it.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: CLK-001 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal]; CLK-001 [witness: verification:staff_bootstrap_client_portal].
statements:
CLK-001: all portal-owned event timestamps written by one operation, other than an
  audit record's `occurred_at`, are equal; an expiry it derives from a TTL is that instant plus its TTL, and source-supplied times, a service credential's supplied `expires_at` among them, keep their supplied values.
quotes: assert _ControlledClock.calls == before + 1, (
assert principal.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and principal.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert issue.credential.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and issue.credential.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert revoked.revoked_at == CLOCK_NOW and revoked.revoked_at.tzinfo is None
assert grant.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and grant.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert disabled.disabled_at == CLOCK_NOW and disabled.disabled_at.tzinfo is None
verdicts.why: The check enforces one clock capture and checks several portal-owned timestamps against that captured instant. It does not cover TTL-derived expiries or preservation of source-supplied times such as a supplied service-credential expires_at.

verdicts.why: The check detects a second active service-principal grant for the same project. It does not test the corresponding uniqueness rule for viewer_id and project_id.
